name: Occurrence
description: One occurrence of an event inside its calendar's window (forge 28e, question 28.7): a one-off has one, a series one per repetition, an exception its own. Written by the app when an event changes and as the window slides; views, free/busy and the tools read these. A person a calendar is shared with as free/busy reads its occurrences (when, busy or free) but not its events, so never their titles.

fields.name: Event
fields.description: The event it is an occurrence of (an exception for an occurrence it replaces)

fields.name: Series
fields.description: The series' master, or the event itself for a one-off

fields.name: Recurrence id
fields.description: The start it has in the series (an instant in UTC, or a date for all-day)

access.read: principal.kind == 'app' || principal.owner || principal.hasRole('calWriter', record.calendar) || principal.hasRole('calReader', record.calendar) || principal.hasRole('calFreeBusy', record.calendar)
